text: Advocate Health Care is a faith-based Illinois/Indiana nonprofit that merged with Aurora Health Care in 2018 to form Advocate Aurora Health, which combined with Atrium Health in 2022 to create Advocate Health, the nonprofit system's ultimate parent. No state ownership or control.

source.name: Advocate Health About Us page
source.quote: In 2022, Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health combined to create Advocate Health, the third-largest nonprofit integrated health system in the U.S.
